before.html:
NodeRoom codebase trace

Portable trace UI for agent apps.

Inspect saved NodeRoom trace records, source captures, UI screenshots, and flow metadata from the bundled snapshot.

npm run understand:noderoom
npm run capture:noderoom:real
npm run trace-coach:sqlite
no API key required
Bundled snapshotverified
SQLite NodeRoom trace browser UI
Source appNodeRoombundled snapshot
Coach steps6ordered labels
Trace tabs4overview, steps, minimap, raw
This saved trace includes source and UI captures, selectors, DOMRects, and flow metadata. It does not run a new capture or agent.
